channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: Americans skipping meals and delaying life decisions as healthcare costs strain households nationwide
item.description: New Gallup surveys show tens of millions of Americans cutting back on food, utilities, and daily necessities to pay medical bills while healthcare affordability worsens.

item.title: Fossil fuels as a weapon of war:’ US-Israeli war on Iran exposes world’s dangerous reliance on oil
item.description: This comes as Israel has struck oil depots in Tehran, blanketing the capital in smoke and toxic rain.

item.title: EPA chief met with Bayer CEO over Supreme Court fight, agency records show
item.description: The June 17 meeting, between officials at the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and Bayer CEO Bill Anderson and two other top Bayer executives, came as Germany-based Bayer was working to quash costly U.S. litigation.

item.title: Senate Democrats demand investigation into Iran school bombing as Fetterman stands apart
item.description: Nearly the entire Democratic caucus calls for a probe into a deadly strike on a girls’ school in Minab while one senator backs the military operation.
